mapper.delete: delete from px_like_record where item_id = #{itemId} and type = #{type} and create_by = #{createBy}
mapper.select: select t.create_by as userId, COALESCE(u.nick_name, CASE WHEN t.create_by LIKE 'fake_like_%' THEN CONCAT('虚拟用户', SUBSTRING(t.create_by, 11)) ELSE t.create_by END) as nickName from (select distinct create_by from px_like_record where create_by is not null and create_by != '' and type = #{type}) t left join sys_user u on t.create_by = u.user_id order by nickName

SELECT f.name AS folder_name, r.type, COUNT(*) AS count FROM px_like_record r INNER JOIN px_wallpaper w ON r.item_id = w.id INNER JOIN px_wallpaper_folder f ON w.folder = f.id WHERE r.type = #{likeType} GROUP BY f.name, r.type ORDER BY count DESC
